evidence.source: International screenshots show a cool light gray application workspace behind white panels.
Dashboard cards, filter panels, tables, sidebar, tabs, and dialogs use flat white surfaces.
Active tabs, primary buttons, pagination, KPI values, and chart emphasis use a purple-blue accent.
Success and Normal table status chips use green/teal tints.
Awaiting approval and warning states use orange tints.
Abnormal, error, and destructive states use red tints.
Inputs, tags, table controls, and compact admin components use restrained 6px to 8px radii.
The screenshots use compact enterprise text with dense tables and navigation rows.
